overview:
Maryland's 7th District is one of the most Democratic-leaning seats in the country, centered on Baltimore and rated D+31. Kweisi Mfume, the incumbent Democrat, is running for re-election and has built a solid financial position, with about $474,000 raised and $656,000 on hand. His Republican challenger, Scott Collier, reports no fundraising on file, and no outside groups are active in the race on either side.

Prediction markets price the Democratic side at roughly 96-97%, and no major ratings outlets or pollsters are tracking the contest, which typically signals a lopsided race. The structural fundamentals point to an expected Democratic margin near 30 points, with the main uncertainty limited to how large the victory ends up being rather than who wins.
